.root { --vt-surface:#ffffff; --vt-surface-2:#f9f9f9; --vt-surface-deep:#36363e; --vt-ink:#17171a; --vt-ink-soft:#717275; --vt-on-deep:#ffffff; --vt-accent:#f65129; --vt-on-accent:#ffffff; --vt-accent-ink:#f65129; --vt-accent-on-deep:#ffd74f; --vt-line:#e9eaeb; font-family:'Manrope','Noto Sans Display',sans-serif; color:var(--vt-ink); background:var(--vt-surface); line-height:1.6; } .root :where(a){color:inherit;text-decoration:none;} .root :where(button){font:inherit;} .root :where(h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6){margin:0;font-weight:600;} .root a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--vt-accent);outline-offset:2px;} .nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:var(--vt-surface);border-bottom:1px solid var(--vt-line);} .navIn{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:1rem 2rem;} .logo{font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700;} .navLinks{display:flex;gap:2rem;} .navLinks a{font-weight:500;color:var(--vt-ink-soft);} .navLinks a:hover{color:var(--vt-accent);} .hero{position:relative;min-height:80vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;} .heroImage{position:absolute;inset:0;background-position:center;background-size:cover;} .heroOverlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--vt-ink);opacity:0.45;} .heroContent{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:4rem 2rem;text-align:center;} .kicker{color:var(--vt-accent-on-deep);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.15em;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:0.5rem;} .heroTitle{font-size:clamp(2.5rem,6vw,4.5rem);line-height:1.1;color:var(--vt-on-deep);} .filterBar{background:var(--vt-surface);border:1px solid var(--vt-line);border-radius:20px;padding:1.5rem;margin-top:2rem;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:1rem;text-align:left;} .filterLabel{color:var(--vt-ink-soft);font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;} .filterTags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.5rem;} .filterTag{background:var(--vt-surface-2);border:1px solid var(--vt-line);border-radius:100px;padding:0.5rem 1rem;font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--vt-ink);transition:all 0.2s;} .filterTag:hover{background:var(--vt-accent);color:var(--vt-on-accent);border-color:var(--vt-accent);} .filterCta{background:var(--vt-accent);color:var(--vt-on-accent);border-radius:100px;padding:0.7rem 1.4rem;font-weight:600;margin-left:auto;transition:all 0.2s;} .filterCta:hover{background:var(--vt-accent-on-deep);color:var(--vt-ink);} .sectionInner{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:5rem 2rem;} .about .sectionInner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4rem;align-items:center;} .smallTitle{color:var(--vt-accent);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.1em;margin-bottom:0.5rem;} .sectionTitle{font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem);line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:1.5rem;} .paragraph{color:var(--vt-ink-soft);font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:1rem;} .aboutImages{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-end;} .aboutImageMain{width:280px;height:280px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;} .aboutImageSmall{width:180px;height:180px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:8px solid var(--vt-surface);margin-left:-50px;margin-bottom:-30px;} .featured{position:relative;padding:6rem 2rem;overflow:hidden;} .featuredBg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-position:center;background-size:cover;} .featuredOverlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--vt-ink);opacity:0.55;} .featuredCard{position:relative;max-width:420px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--vt-accent-on-deep);border-top:10px solid var(--vt-accent);border-radius:20px;padding:2rem 2.5rem;color:var(--vt-ink);} .featuredTitle{font-size:1.8rem;margin-bottom:1rem;} .featuredHours{font-weight:600;white-space:pre-line;} .services{background:var(--vt-surface-2);} .servicesGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:1.5rem;} .serviceCard{background:var(--vt-surface);border:1px solid var(--vt-line);border-radius:16px;padding:2rem;transition:border-color 0.2s;} .serviceCard:hover{border-color:var(--vt-accent);} .serviceNum{display:inline-block;background:var(--vt-accent-on-deep);color:var(--vt-ink);border-radius:100px;padding:0.3rem 0.8rem;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:1rem;} .serviceTitle{font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:0.5rem;} .serviceDesc{color:var(--vt-ink-soft);} .portfolio{background:var(--vt-surface);} .portfolioGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1.5rem;} .portfolioCard{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--vt-surface);border:1px solid var(--vt-line);} .portfolioMedia{aspect-ratio:1/1;overflow:hidden;} .portfolioMedia img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 0.4s;} .portfolioCard:hover .portfolioMedia img{transform:scale(1.05);} .portfolioBody{padding:1rem 1.2rem 1.2rem;} .portfolioTitle{font-size:1.25rem;margin-bottom:0.25rem;} .portfolioSub{color:var(--vt-ink-soft);font-size:0.95rem;} .contact{background:var(--vt-surface-2);padding-bottom:0;} .contact .sectionInner{padding-top:4rem;padding-bottom:4rem;} .contactGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2rem;align-items:start;} .wave{display:block;width:100%;height:90px;line-height:0;font-size:0;margin-bottom:-1px;} .footer{background:var(--vt-surface-deep);color:var(--vt-on-deep);} .footerTop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:2rem;padding-bottom:2rem;} .footerBrand{color:var(--vt-on-deep);} .copyright{color:var(--vt-on-deep);opacity:0.8;text-align:center;padding-bottom:0;} @media (max-width: 768px){ .navIn{flex-wrap:wrap;} .navLinks{order:3;width:100%;justify-content:center;gap:1rem;padding-top:0.5rem;} .about .sectionInner{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2rem;} .aboutImages{margin-top:2rem;} .portfolioGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} .contactGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} .footerTop{flex-direction:column;text-align:center;} } @media (max-width: 480px){ .portfolioGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} .filterBar{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;text-align:center;} .filterCta{margin-left:0;text-align:center;} .featuredCard{padding:1.5rem;} }

deviations.why: No genuine testimonial data exists in the data contract; faking would violate the truth contract.
Unsubstantiated and not traceable in the data contract.
No checkout flow or wishlist feature is supported in Vitrina.

deviations.what: Replaced hero search/filter form with category tag row
deviations.why: Search is not supported in a static server component; tags preserve the white filter bar visual.
Demo data does not include a price field for gallery items.
No backend or form action exists in the static server component; contact info comes from FindUs and SocialLinks.
Uses available data and gives the template a complete Vitrina structure while retaining the source rhythm.

deviations.what: About section uses one large and one small circular image
deviations.why: Only two image string fields are guaranteed (HERO_IMAGE, STORY_IMAGE); small image is derived from gallery[0] when available.

notes: Faithful port of Moso Interior: warm palette, coral accent, wavy footer, opening-hours card, and product grid are preserved. The demo's missing price/duration fields are intentionally not rendered.
